title: BlueCodeAgent: A BLUE TEAMING AGENT ENABLED BY AUTOMATED RED TEAMING FOR CODEGEN AI
findings: The paper finds that its proposed method, BlueCodeAgent, improves the detection of biased instructions across various categories, including religion. However, it does not provide specific performance metrics for the religion category alone; the results are aggregated for the general task of bias instruction detection.
